==Usage==
This template is to be used for issues of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Figurine Collection]]''. Place the following code on the page and replace the "issue number" with the appropriate information.
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>FigurineCite|ISSUE NUMBER|DEPARTMENT}}

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{FigurineCite|48|Species and Beings}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{FigurineCite|48|Species and Beings}}

[[Category:Reference magazine citation templates|FigurineCite]]</noinclude>
